SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR-1 and SMB-TYPE-INDENT-SPACING-1 appear in the index with a null ledger status; the latter is in progress (stopped at the C: cap) and drives the LOCAL rows.
ui: window = a control exists in the harness-view egui host; command = typed command or engine only; unknown = no implementation. The native Vulkan host was not inspected separately.
